# <span id="aanchor404"></span> Source Analysis Rollups

The Source Analysis Rollups viewer summarizes gas or liquid quality data to hourly, daily and monthly resolutions for a wide selection of time frames. By default, the viewing parameters are daily resolution and previous contract month on a single source. Data will only be visible if the source has Enabled Rollups checked on the Main tab in the Quality Source editor and Type is set to Chromatograph on the Characteristic tab.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Source Analysis Rollups viewer:

Go to **Open** \> **Rollup Viewers** \> **Source Analysis Rollups**.

You may view a single source or a list of sources. If you select a list, you can use the **Next** and **Previous** buttons to navigate through the list.

- Click the **Show** button to identify where the source has data to view.
- Click the **Open** button to open the appropriate Source Analysis Editor (liquid or gas) on the selected source.
- Click the **Unrolled Data** button to display the Rollup Queue Viewer.
- Click the **Refresh** button to update the display for the selected time frame.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 560;height: 401;" />

Print the graph by going to **File** \> **Print**.

</div>
